user.description: Connect to the Mean Well XDR power supply over Modbus TCP. Integrations that use the same link share one connection.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the Modbus TCP gateway the power supply is attached to.
data_description.port: The TCP port of the Modbus gateway.
data_description.unit_id: The power supply's Modbus slave address (factory default 131 = 0x83).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check that the power supply is reachable on the given host, port and unit address.

abort.already_configured: This power supply is already configured.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often the power supply is read.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between read cycles. The device answers one request at a time, and several power supplies on one link share it.
